channel.title: RomNYC — NYC Facts
channel.description: Short New York City facts for the RomNYC livestream ticker.

item.title: 🗽 NYC FACT: The five boroughs became one city in 1898.
item.description: The Bronx, Brooklyn, Manhattan, Queens and Staten Island were consolidated into Greater New York in 1898.

item.title: 🚇 NYC FACT: The first NYC subway opened in 1904.
item.description: The first subway line ran from City Hall to 145th Street in Manhattan.

item.title: 🌉 NYC FACT: The Brooklyn Bridge opened in 1883.
item.description: It became the first permanent bridge connecting Manhattan and Brooklyn.

item.title: 🗽 NYC FACT: The Statue of Liberty was a gift from France.
item.description: The Statue of Liberty was dedicated in New York Harbor in 1886.

item.title: 🏙️ NYC FACT: The Empire State Building opened in 1931.
item.description: It was completed in roughly 13 months during the Great Depression.

item.title: 🌳 NYC FACT: Central Park covers about 843 acres.
item.description: Central Park is larger than the country of Monaco.

item.title: 🍕 NYC FACT: Lombardi's is widely regarded as America's first licensed pizzeria.
item.description: The historic pizzeria opened in Little Italy in the early 20th century.

item.title: 🚢 NYC FACT: The Staten Island Ferry is free.
item.description: The ferry connects Lower Manhattan and Staten Island and offers views of the Statue of Liberty.

item.title: 🏙️ NYC FACT: Queens is the largest NYC borough by land area.
item.description: Queens covers more land than any of the city's other four boroughs.

item.title: 🌊 NYC FACT: The East River is actually a tidal strait.
item.description: Despite its name, the East River is a tidal waterway connecting New York Harbor with Long Island Sound.
